mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS for 3 months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates and sell equities.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative FEDFUNDS trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 5.0% in 3 months signals a strong labor market, boosting economic confidence and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 5.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (GDP) and INDPRO (industrial production) rising for 2 months signals a robust supply-demand balance, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise for 2 months
failure_condition: No positive 60-day returns when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5% for 3 months signals aggressive rate hikes, causing investor caution and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns in tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS above 2.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE rising above 6.0% in 1 month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when UNRATE crosses above 6.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (business investment) increasing for 3 months signals robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: Both HOUST and RSAFS rise for 3 months
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high FEDFUNDS (above 1.8% for 3 months) signals aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher rates.
failure_condition: Positive returns despite sustained high FEDFUNDS (above 1.8% for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, UNRATE falling below 4.5% for 2 months signals strong labor market conditions, boosting confidence and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when UNRATE drops below 4.5% in late-cycle expansion.
